propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrappers, unlike all other store write paths which route through gitutil.run_git_write and self-heal transient read faults
the observed CI failure 'fatal: bad object HEAD' indicates a merge commit object was absent from the git object database at bundle time, not that HEAD reference was unresolvable
the same transient object-database read fault class is fatal in s3_doctor but handled gracefully by existing retry infrastructure in other store operations
s3_doctor._git must be routed through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit the per-store advisory git-op lock, index/ref-lock retry, and transient read-fault retry
the missing-object signature 'bad object' must be added to the transient marker family in gitutil so it triggers automatic retry without growing a new retry loop or module
